landing.badge: A considered starting point for your next product
landing.description: Spend less time rebuilding the same foundations and more time shaping the experience your customers need. Start with the essentials, then make it yours.
landing.whyTitle: You don't have to start from scratch.
landing.whyDescription: The common flows and screens are already connected, so you can spend your time on what makes the product yours.
landing.capabilityAuthDesc: A clear user journey from sign-in and two-factor authentication to email verification.
landing.capabilityAdminDesc: Manage users, permissions, notices, and operational data from day one.
landing.capabilityI18nDesc: Localized routing and metadata help you prepare for more markets from the start.
landing.includedTitle: The pieces you need are already in place.
landing.includedDescription: Compose and extend the system around your product direction. Good defaults make the next decision easier.
